v7_false_success.description: ISOLATED regression check for the commands that report success while doing nothing. Correct is executed=4 failed=2. Any lower failed count means a command reported success for work it never did.

v7_must_fail_devtool.description: Every toolkit command here must be counted as failed. Expect executed=11 failed=11.
commands: devtool log block_place on radius notanumber

v7_must_fail_selectors.description: A selector matching nothing is an error, not an invitation to pick one. Expect executed=4 failed=2.

v7_relative_coords_succeed.description: Relative coordinates from a PLAYER sender resolve against their position and must SUCCEED. Only a console sender, which has no meaningful position, is refused. Expect executed=4 failed=0.

v7_must_fail_vanilla.description: Vanilla command failures must be classified as failures too. Expect all three failed.

v7_must_succeed_no_effect.description: The opposite rule. A command that runs and changes nothing has SUCCEEDED. Expect executed=3 failed=0. If this reports a failure, teardown bundles become unusable on their second run.

v7_mixed.description: Failures interleaved with successes, to confirm the counters do not drift. Expect executed=7 failed=3.
